news.title: Stuut’s $52.5M Series B Shows Microsoft Betting the Agent Economy’s Revenue Layer Is Already Here
Stuut Raises $52.5 Million to Scale Agentic AI Across Enterprise Order-to-Cash
Stuut Raises $52.5M Series B to Automate Enterprise Receivables

bullets: Translate Stuut’s vision for AR into shipped product outcomes that are customer and market evidenced.
Be customer-obsessed: synthesize their needs, track and evaluate competitor positioning, and transform these insights into rapidly testable hypotheses.
Build fast, low-fidelity prototypes to resolve product debates and settle on decisions in days, not weeks. Bring ideas directly in front of customers to pressure-test direction…
Partner and embed deeply with engineering and design, holding the pen as we execute on projects and steering them towards customer and business goals.
Set the operational foundations for growth by instituting foundational product frameworks, roadmaps, and dashboards.
